description: This file contains extension methods for managing features in OrchardCore's shell environment, including enabling, disabling, updating, and checking features asynchronously.

classes.name: ShellFeaturesManagerExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IShellFeaturesManager to manage features asynchronously.

methods.name: EnableFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Enables a collection of features asynchronously.

methods.name: EnableFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Enables features by their identifiers asynchronously, with an optional force parameter.

methods.name: UpdateFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Updates the state of features to disable or enable specified features asynchronously.

methods.name: DisableFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Disables a collection of features asynchronously.

methods.name: DisableFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Disables features by their identifiers asynchronously.

methods.name: IsFeatureEnabledAsync
methods.description: Checks if a specific feature is enabled asynchronously.
